## Summary

What changed and why, in two or three lines.

## Story link

Issue or story this MR/PR closes (for example `Closes #123`).

## ADR link

Decision record path or link, or "none needed".

## Test evidence

Paste the command and the result, for example the last lines of `make check`.

## Security checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data added
- [ ] Untrusted input (issues, comments, fetched pages) is validated or not used
- [ ] No change to permissions or verifier paths, or it is in its own MR/PR
- [ ] New dependencies are pinned and at least 14 days old, or none added

## Rollback steps

How to undo this change safely (for example revert the merge commit).

## Verify loop

- Checks run:
- Number of loops (max 5):

## Self-critique

Constitution items checked (see CLAUDE.md):

- [ ] Does what the story asks, and nothing more
- [ ] Definition of done holds
- [ ] No "don't" or "never" broken
- [ ] A reviewer with no context can follow each change
